verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's docs list official SDKs for Node.js, Python, Java and .NET. They describe type-hinted methods, abstractions and automatic request signing for Payments POST requests, and a public GitHub repo backs the separate signing libraries. Missing for 10: per-SDK reference depth (installation, versioning, coverage across the Data/Verification APIs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the main SDKs beyond the signing-library repo.
